premises: Cr and Nb enrichment in a surface layer on Q235 steel promotes a uniform, adherent passivating film.
Such a Cr/Nb-enriched passivation film suppresses pitting initiation in chloride environments.
The beneficial effect of Cr/Nb enrichment is effective at both room temperature and ~60°C.
Untreated Q235 steel has a non-uniform, poorly protective oxide layer.
